cohort: 120 neonates admitted to the neonatal Intensive Care Unit at Tanta University Hospital with neonatal jaundice.
finding: Oral fenofibrate (10 mg/kg single dose) with phototherapy was more effective at reducing total serum bilirubin levels in neonates with jaundice compared to oral phenobarbitone (3 mg/kg/day for 3 days) with phototherapy.
